title: Audit and remediate tooltip timing, skip-links, and high-contrast chart overlays for VPAT readiness
creator: Aisha Patel
description: This ticket covers a focused accessibility audit and remediation pass across chart overlays and dense data visuals: specifically tooltip interaction timing, presence and behavior of skip-links for chart regions, keyboard navigation around overlays, and ensuring chart overlay styles meet high-contrast VPAT requirements using design tokens. The goal is to make chart overlays and tooltips predictable for keyboard and screen reader users, and to produce artifacts for the VPAT checklist.
acceptance_criteria: Tooltips across chart components have a consistent keyboard-accessible trigger and a configurable debounce (default 200ms) to avoid spurious announcements for screen readers.
All chart overlays (legends, series detail popovers, mini-tooltips) have ARIA roles/attributes: meaningful aria-label or aria-describedby, and do not steal focus unexpectedly.
Page-level skip-link to main chart content is present and visible on keyboard focus; activation lands focus on the primary chart container with an appropriate landmark role.
High-contrast theme tokens applied to chart overlays meet WCAG AA for normal text (4.5:1) and AA Large (3:1) where applicable; token overrides documented for designers and engineers.
Keyboard tab order is linear and logical around dense tables and charts; overlay open/close uses Escape to dismiss and returns focus to the invoking control.
Design and engineering have produced a VPAT artifact section describing how each chart overlay pattern maps to VPAT criteria with sample markup and test steps.
Automated visual regression jobs added to CI that capture high-contrast overlay states and tooltip open/close transitions for at least Chrome + VoiceOver and Firefox + NVDA smoke tests.
tasks: Audit live components across repo to produce inventory of tooltip/overlay patterns (DESIGN: map tokens, ENG: map implementations)
Propose token-level high-contrast variants and document usage in chart token spec
Implement consistent tooltip debounce and keyboard activation in chart component library
Add aria-describedby references and ensure no role conflicts for overlays
Add skip-link implementation and e2e test that verifies landing spot and focus visibility
Create VPAT checklist entry and include HTML examples in confluence doc
Ship small release with docs, token updates, and PRs for engineering review
